prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Generate ONE finished BLACK JOKER for the Chinese-themed Design 2 playing-card deck.
REFERENCE 1 is authoritative for Design 2 style, palette, narrow gold lotus-vine frame, ivory margins, fine print illustration, dense lotus fields and cartouche positions. REFERENCE 2 is ONLY a structural guide for the double-ended entertainer and vertically stacked JOKER lettering; do not copy its European costume, cap or Renaissance ornament.
Full 5:7 portrait card, target 1060x1484. Outer band Lamp Black with gold/ivory lotus vines as reference1. Dense black floral fields of teal leaves, red/ivory lotuses, cream flowers and berries around a scalloped ivory reserve with pale gold cloud/lotus tracery. Rich restrained natural painted face modeling, exceptionally fine detailed embroidered silk. Keep a generous amount of floral ornament visible around relatively modest figures.
Two waist-up portraits of the SAME adult Chinese male entertainer, about 35, warm mischievous smile, expressive eyes, neat small moustache, no beard. One upright in upper half, matching one rotated 180 degrees below, arranged as a balanced reversible court-card composition around a central small turquoise jewel in a gold lotus rosette. Heads face gently viewer RIGHT when their half is upright; bottom nose consequently projects page LEFT. Sleeves extend close to the inner sides. No crowns or official side-winged caps: a modest soft folded black cloth cap with a small gold lotus clasp. Wear charcoal-black silk robe with luxuriant teal-and-gold lotus embroidery, red inner collar and crimson sash, cream cuff lining, a few decorative gold tassels. Chinese-inspired fictional court entertainer, graceful and dignified, playful rather than caricature.
Upper figure holds an OPEN IVORY FOLDING FAN on viewer RIGHT near chest/shoulder, visible dark bamboo ribs, fine pale-gold cloud design and one red lotus on the fan. Fan is fully inside frame and does not cover the face. Other hand lightly lifts the edge of his sash in a relaxed theatrical gesture. Repeat pose/fan rotated 180 degrees below. No pike, weapon, staff or European jester horns.
Upper-left ivory index cartouche contains five BLACK serif letters stacked vertically top-to-bottom: J O K E R, all upright, no suit pip. Lower-right has the exact same JOKER index rotated 180 degrees, as reference2. Exactly these two words, no extra text. Preserve reference1's gold outlines and lotus tips on index cartouches. Output just the full flat card, no perspective, mockup, watermark or signature.
